alt.en: A sepia photograph of the long side of a great Gothic chapel across a wide lawn: a row of tall pointed windows divided by buttresses topped with slender pinnacles, and a tall turret at each corner.
alt.es: Fotografía en sepia del largo costado de una gran capilla gótica al otro lado de un amplio césped: una hilera de altos ventanales apuntados separados por contrafuertes rematados con esbeltos pináculos, y una alta torrecilla en cada esquina.

caption.en: King's College Chapel, Cambridge, in an albumen print of about 1870. Since 1919 Once in Royal David's City has opened the chapel's Christmas Eve service, A Festival of Nine Lessons and Carols, with its first verse sung by a single treble.
caption.es: La capilla del King's College de Cambridge, en una copia a la albúmina de hacia 1870. Desde 1919, Once in Royal David's City abre el servicio de Nochebuena de la capilla, A Festival of Nine Lessons and Carols, con la primera estrofa cantada por un niño solista.

source: King's College Chapel, Cambridge, albumen print from a bound album of 58 Cambridge University photographs, about 1870, photographs taken for William Winfield
